items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I played a little loft thing with him, he and Bill Dixon.

ctx.x: Then Sonny Rollins had a -- let me see. No, Archie Shappeldon (PHONETIC) -- now, I'd never -- I only worked one job with Archie. I knew him before I went back to Chicago. I played a little loft thing with him, he and Bill Dixon. That was back before I got sick. Had to be the early '60s. I didn't pay too much attention to what they were talking about avant the garde. I just played whatever came into my head, whether it was inside or outside. They took it on out, you know what I mean, which was beautiful. I ran…
